card.name: Eye-flushing instructions after eye contact
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs inside instructions to flush or rinse the eyes with water after contact, such as hold, of, for, at least, before the duration.

modes.description: Words like of, for, least between 'copious amounts' and 'water' or the minutes of flushing.
